cards.graphic_features: Основная прямоугольная область, функция в первой строке; без дополнительных полей

normative_mandatory: main rectangle, first main-field row with function (§2.1.1–2.1.2)
input/left output/right or explicit permitted orientation (§2.1.4–2.1.6)
pin number ABOVE lead; left of input lead/right of output lead, optional gap in lead (§2.3.12)
forbid line at rectangular contour corner (§2.1.5)
body W/H calculated from actual font, rows, pin lines and field count (§2.1.7)
normative_recommended: function notation as short as possible while retaining unique meaning; §2.2.1 has NO character-count limit
modular_reference: appendix 5 RECOMMENDED table19 pos1: adjacent lead centerline pitch ≥2 M on modular grid
other pointer offsets in M, never auto-reinterpret M as fixed mm
editorial_only: component size and position after real ink and line clearance
external lead lengths and SVG coordinate grid in integer µm
prohibited_unverified_mm: absolute W/H in mm unless a source arrow explicitly dimensions this exact symbol
pin length and symbol-specific arc radius from scan pixels

long function designation grows rectangle by actual glyph-ink width
optional field separator omitted only with sufficient ambiguity-safe text spacing

corner-attached lead
hidden second unit creates duplicate physical pin number
function text or pin label overlaps separator
modular M in mm claimed mandatory with no defined M
